questions.stem_text: Millions of people living all over the world have cancer. Is cancer a pandemic?

options.A: No, because cancer is not contagious.
options.B: No, because cancer is not always fatal.
options.C: Yes, because millions of people have cancer.
options.D: Yes, because people all over the world have cancer.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - No, because cancer is not contagious.
